# Tax deadline calendar

My own dates only. Client dates live in the practice software. In the phone calendar with two alerts each (14 days, 2 days).

## 2025

- [x] **31 Jan 2025**: 2023/24 return filed (done 17 Jan) + balancing payment £2,502.60 + 1st POA 2024/25 £7,441.30. Total £9,943.90, paid
- [x] 28 Feb 2025: last day before the 5% late payment penalty on anything still owed for 2023/24. Nothing owed
- [ ] 5 Apr 2025: last day to buy back the 2013/14 NI gap (£824). Also ISA, JISA, pension allowances for 2024/25 run out
- [ ] 6 Apr 2025: new ISA allowance, do the bed-and-ISA from the GIA
- [ ] 31 May 2025: P60 for Javier from the academy
- [ ] 6 Jul 2025: P11D for Javier's medical cover (should match the corrected code, see [[Tax code letters]])
- [ ] **31 Jul 2025**: 2nd payment on account 2024/25, **£7,441.30**. Tax space must hold this by mid-July
- [ ] 5 Oct 2025: deadline to register for SA if new source of income (not relevant unless the VAT question changes things, see [[VAT registration threshold]])
- [ ] 31 Oct 2025: paper return deadline (never use paper)
- [ ] 30 Dec 2025: online filing deadline if wanting a balance under £3,000 collected through PAYE. Not relevant, no PAYE
- [ ] **31 Jan 2026**: 2024/25 return + balancing payment + 1st POA 2025/26. Gilt T26 matures 30 Jan, £6,000, see [[Bond ladder]]

## 2026 and after

- 6 Apr 2026: Making Tax Digital starts for me. Quarterly updates due 7 Aug, 7 Nov, 7 Feb, 7 May
- 31 May 2026: Nationwide fix ends, not tax but on the same calendar because I'll forget otherwise

## Penalties to remember

- Late filing: £100 immediately, then £10 a day after 3 months up to £900
- Late payment: 5% at 30 days, another 5% at 6 months and 12 months, plus interest at base + 4%
